site_schema.summary: The schema presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering provider and advertises generative AI development services, neither of which matches the approved staffing and recruiting description. It also contains unsupported or inaccurate service promises, founder claims, timelines, and security and performance guarantees.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI Engineering positioning
llm_problems.issue: The schema describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning throughout the schema with positioning aligned to the approved company description and current services.
